cc/sign/aries/lived-behaviors: generates ideas about identity/style/projects faster than plans to execute them; wants to act on inspiration immediately; equates directness with courage; talks self out of investing in own goals when the inner critic spikes; feels anxious precisely where usually energized.
cc/sign/aries/hook-moves: name the surplus ("You've got great ideas"); hand over agency ("The floor is yours"); normalize doubt ("We all live with doubt").
cc/sign/aries/actions: make a plan and start moving; say the thing directly; invest in yourself; don't wait for instant results; name where resource tension is building.
cc/sign/aries/closings: name the courage it took; "the inspiration is worth acting on"; permission to fake confidence until it's real.
cc/sign/taurus/lived-behaviors: gets stuck in a critical thought loop and treats it as fact; forces solutions instead of letting timing work; resists the "pressurizing/challenging" stretch of a transit; undervalues small brave self-examination.
cc/sign/taurus/hook-moves: pair forces ("Motivation, meet inspiration"); challenge the inner critic ("Not everything your inner critic says is true"); permission to slow ("Go easy on yourself").
cc/sign/taurus/actions: follow instincts; interrupt the thought loop; don't force a fix now; check on personal goals and name the self-care actually needed.
cc/sign/taurus/closings: "this weirdness will pass"; reframe as growth; dare one small brave action.
cc/sign/gemini/lived-behaviors: has surplus social energy but scatters it; needs the group chat / community to regulate nerves; hesitates to make the first move; overdoes stimulation past the point of moderation.
cc/sign/gemini/hook-moves: name the surplus energy; offer motivation as a question ("Need a little motivation?"); normalize anxiety.
cc/sign/gemini/actions: make a plan; go mingle; put yourself out there; reset when bandwidth is gone and retry later.
cc/sign/gemini/closings: "your people are waiting"; moderation is key; first moves build stronger bonds.
cc/sign/cancer/lived-behaviors: sits on bold ideas rather than sharing them; tries to do it all alone; hides away when overwhelmed; measures life by meaning added, not boxes checked.
cc/sign/cancer/hook-moves: name the inspiration; separate having-dreams from acting; make connection a "must."
cc/sign/cancer/actions: open to new approaches; let others help; spread the news; trim what doesn't matter to focus on roles that do.
cc/sign/cancer/closings: leads worth chasing; honesty beats hoarding ideas; visibility is the only way to make a mark.
cc/sign/leo/lived-behaviors: performs certainty while privately uncertain; chases big/"unrealistic" goals; needs grounding rituals before being "on"; forgets the journey is the point.
cc/sign/leo/hook-moves: "trust your inner compass"; affirm shine; offer a change ("Want to make some changes?").
cc/sign/leo/actions: research before leaping; find one small way to act on a big dream; don't second-guess; practice calming habits before the spotlight.
cc/sign/leo/closings: stay open to many paths; "the journey is the whole point"; get comfortable with uncertainty.
cc/sign/virgo/lived-behaviors: fills gaps with wishful thinking, then it backfires; overanalyzes good things; rushes to clarify fine print; gaslights own perceptions.
cc/sign/virgo/hook-moves: puncture mind-reading ("You can't read minds"); "trust your inner compass"; anti-gaslight ("Don't gaslight yourself").
cc/sign/virgo/actions: notice where wishful thinking is filling gaps; clarify expectations without rushing; say yes to the collaboration; count to 10.
cc/sign/virgo/closings: clarifying now smooths connections; instincts can find a solution that works for everyone; no rush on the fine print.
cc/sign/libra/lived-behaviors: swaps diplomacy for avoidance; keeps rose-colored glasses on relationships; plays it cool when directness is needed; carries relationship setbacks forward.
cc/sign/libra/hook-moves: ask about relationship insight; "it's okay to be blunt with your loved ones"; normalize anxiety.
cc/sign/libra/actions: see connections as they really are; start the overdue conversation; swap diplomacy for directness; notice what shifted with loved ones.
cc/sign/libra/closings: focus on how people make you feel; face facts, then invest in connections that matter; "no time to play it cool."
cc/sign/scorpio/lived-behaviors: pushes through the daily grind without zooming out; overthinks whether there's a catch; chooses being right over connecting; risks burnout by not cooling off.
cc/sign/scorpio/hook-moves: name inspiration in routines; "it's time to take action"; "be upfront with yourself."
cc/sign/scorpio/actions: let it happen; stop and plan how to make it real; zoom out and reassess routines; count to 10; ask "right, or connected?"
cc/sign/scorpio/closings: support is an evolving practice; "there doesn't always have to be a catch"; cool off so you don't burn out; "you're braver than you think."
cc/sign/sagittarius/lived-behaviors: juggles a busy home life; lets wishful thinking fill gaps; keeps daydreams private; overcomplicates play; rushes a good time.
cc/sign/sagittarius/hook-moves: name the home juggle; "let inspiration lead"; "take charge of your creative or romantic life."
cc/sign/sagittarius/actions: carve out playtime (with kids or yourself); don't overcomplicate; show the imagination; share the daydreams.
cc/sign/sagittarius/closings: comfort is worth the care; "wisdom in not rushing"; soak it up; don't keep daydreams to yourself.
cc/sign/capricorn/lived-behaviors: aims high but overrides rest; makes rash moves under stress; postpones fun until "earned"; needs a refresh at the roots (home/family).
cc/sign/capricorn/hook-moves: spotlight home life; "it's great to aim high" (then temper); "it's time for a refresh."
cc/sign/capricorn/actions: no rash decisions; start with one small action; put it all on the table; focus on roots; count to 10.
cc/sign/capricorn/closings: you'll learn which instincts to follow; "start with one small action and go from there"; try a new approach and find your courage.
cc/sign/aquarius/lived-behaviors: has a million ideas and over-commits; crosses wires in communication; overthinks instead of enjoying; sprints to feel accomplished.
cc/sign/aquarius/hook-moves: name the idea-flood; "tap the brakes"; "don't mince your words."
cc/sign/aquarius/actions: focus on the few you're most excited about; take action however small; use challenges to level up; follow hunches; name home-life tension.
cc/sign/aquarius/closings: leaning in improves choices; "you don't have to sprint to feel accomplished"; you decide how you express yourself.
cc/sign/pisces/lived-behaviors: procrastinates on inspiration; runs a balancing act; doubts own bravery; falls for get-rich-quick shortcuts; needs to treat progress as a marathon.
cc/sign/pisces/hook-moves: "act on your inspiration today"; name the balancing act; "no more procrastinating."
cc/sign/pisces/actions: pay attention; take one step toward a money goal; stop doubting; use hiccups to rework the plan; get involved locally; count to 10.
cc/sign/pisces/closings: "a marathon, not a sprint"; "no catch"; "your wallet will thank you"; confidence comes from leaving the comfort zone.

cc/aspect-pair/venus-sextile-neptune: A gentle opening around love, art, and imagination — inspiration that can become real if you act on it instead of only admiring it. Don't let fear of disappointment stop you reaching. Make one tangible, beautiful thing with what's already here.
cc/aspect-pair/venus-opposition-pluto: Closeness runs into power: jealousy, control, or the uneasy sense you've been giving far more than you get back. What's imbalanced gets exposed. Get clear on what you actually want from the connection before reacting to the intensity.

cc/aspect-pair/mercury-opposition-chiron: Something said or heard touches an old sore spot, and words land harder than intended. It's an opening for repair, not only for hurt. Use it for the honest, healing conversation rather than the defensive one.
cc/aspect-pair/sun-square-saturn: Your direction meets an obstacle — a limit, a duty, or an authority saying not yet. It can feel like being blocked or doubted. Treat it as a test of commitment: do the unglamorous part, and the confidence you build is real rather than borrowed.
cc/aspect-pair/sun-opposition-saturn: Your goals run up against hard reality or someone else's constraints, and the gap between where you are and where you want to be feels stark. Don't read the limit as a verdict on your worth. Name what's in your control and put steady work there.
cc/aspect-pair/venus-square-saturn: Warmth meets caution: a relationship, or your sense of being valued, feels tested, distant, or effortful, and doubt about being wanted can creep in. Ask for what you need directly instead of withdrawing, and let the connection prove itself through what people do.
cc/aspect-pair/mars-square-pluto: Drive meets intensity, and force wants to become domination — of a situation or a person. Power struggles and all-or-nothing pushes are the trap. Aim the intensity at real change rather than winning, and don't torch a bridge you'll need.
cc/aspect-pair/mercury-square-neptune: Thinking gets foggy, idealized, or hard to pin down; facts blur and it's easy to hear what you want to hear. Don't sign or promise on a hunch. Check the details against something solid before you commit.

cc/ref/aspect-psychology/aspect-as-proce: An aspect is not a fixed verdict but a live process linking two drives, and worked with consciously it can give each of them more freedom rather than less.
cc/ref/aspect-psychology/conjunction: A conjunction fuses two functions so tightly they act as one, which concentrates their power and makes them hard to separate or moderate.
cc/ref/aspect-psychology/opposition: An opposition sets two functions facing each other, felt as an inner see-saw or projected onto other people, and it asks for balance rather than choosing a side.
cc/ref/aspect-psychology/square: A square is friction between two functions that will not resolve on its own, and it is usually the engine of real growth because it forces action.
cc/ref/aspect-psychology/trine: A trine lets two functions cooperate so easily that the talent can go unnoticed and undeveloped, gift and laziness in one.
cc/ref/aspect-psychology/sextile: A sextile is opportunity that only pays off when acted on; left alone it simply passes.
cc/ref/aspect-psychology/unaspected-plan: A planet with no major aspects works in isolation, often all-or-nothing, and should never be ignored when weighing a chart.
cc/ref/aspect-psychology/applying-vs-sep: An applying aspect is still building and carries more force; a separating one is fading and describes something already set in motion.
cc/ref/aspect-psychology/hard-and-soft: Hard aspects build character through friction, soft aspects supply ease and resource, and a whole chart needs both to be capable and driven.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/synastry-is: Synastry reads the relationship as its own astrology rather than two charts side by side, treating feelings and bonds as part of the whole person, not a separate compartment.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/compatibility-m: Easy compatibility is not the same as a good relationship; friction contacts often carry the growth, and a too-smooth chart can lack charge.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/venus-mars: Venus-to-Mars contacts carry the erotic and creative spark, the pull of wanting and being wanted; they show attraction, not whether it lasts.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/sun-moon: Sun-to-Moon contacts are among the most binding, the sense of being fundamentally understood and at home with each other.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/saturn-contacts: Saturn contacts both bind and test; they can commit a relationship or weigh it down, and they ask whether the bond can bear reality over time.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/moon-contacts: Moon contacts set the emotional safety of the bond, how held or how exposed each person feels day to day.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/outer-planet-co: Outer-planet contacts bring fascination, idealization, or intensity, and are best held lightly because they distort as much as they attract.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/house-overlay: Where one person's planets fall in the other's houses shows which areas of life each activates in the other, the practical stage the contact plays out on.
cc/ref/synastry-dynamics/inherited-belie: People carry beliefs about relationships from past experience into every new contact, and those expectations color how a contact is actually felt.
cc/ref/nodes/north-node-is: The North Node is the growth edge, the unfamiliar direction the life is reaching toward; it feels awkward at first and proves deeply nourishing over time.
cc/ref/nodes/south-node-is: The South Node is familiar, already-mastered ground, comfortable and quietly depleting; it is what to lean out of, not to abandon.
cc/ref/nodes/node-axis: The nodes are a single axis, the Dragon's Head and Tail, intake and release; you grow by moving energy from the South toward the North.
cc/ref/nodes/node-compass: The North Node works like a practical compass, offering the concrete next step rather than a grand destiny.
cc/ref/nodes/south-node-synastry: A planet touching another person's South Node suggests a deep, old familiarity, a bond that feels already known.
cc/ref/nodes/node-by-sign-house: The nodal signs describe the quality to release and the quality to develop, and the houses show the life areas where that shift takes place.
cc/ref/outer-planets/uranus-is: Uranus is the awakener: sudden insight, freedom, and the urge to break a pattern grown too narrow. It liberates and destabilizes in the same motion.
cc/ref/outer-planets/uranus-transit: Under a Uranus transit, what erupts has usually been building underneath for a long time; the suddenness is the surfacing, not the cause.
cc/ref/outer-planets/neptune-is: Neptune dissolves boundaries into longing, imagination, and compassion, and also into illusion; it offers transcendence and the fog of wishful seeing together.
cc/ref/outer-planets/neptune-transit: A Neptune transit blurs the edges of whatever it touches, offering inspiration and loss of certainty at once, so discernment matters more than usual.
cc/ref/outer-planets/pluto-is: Pluto is slow, total transformation through what is buried, feared, or denied; it composts the old rather than reforming it.
cc/ref/outer-planets/pluto-transit: A Pluto transit works underground and by attrition, and by the time the change is visible it is usually already irreversible.
cc/ref/outer-planets/saturn-is: Saturn is the boundary and the teacher: limit, time, fear, and the maturity earned by meeting them. What it restricts, it eventually makes solid.
cc/ref/outer-planets/saturn-transit: A Saturn transit asks for realism and structure in the area it crosses, removes what was never built to last, and rewards patient work.
cc/ref/outer-planets/generational: The outer planets move slowly and color whole generations; in a personal chart they matter most by house and by aspect to the personal planets.
cc/ref/transit-principles/transit-is: A transit is a current-sky planet activating a natal point, switching that part of the chart on for a while; the natal promise sets what is possible and the transit sets the timing.
cc/ref/transit-principles/fast-vs-slow: Fast transits from the Moon, Mercury, Venus, and Sun color days; slow transits from Saturn outward mark chapters and are where real development happens.
cc/ref/transit-principles/applying-orb: A transit is strongest as it applies to exactness and while the orb is tight; the effect builds toward the hit and settles afterward.
cc/ref/transit-principles/hard-vs-soft: Hard transits bring the pressure and the events; soft transits open doors that still need to be walked through.
cc/ref/transit-principles/natal-conditio: A transit lands according to the natal planet's own condition; it activates what is already there rather than importing something foreign.
cc/ref/transit-principles/triple-pass: Slow-planet transits often perfect three times, direct then retrograde then direct, giving a first pass, a review, and a resolution.
cc/ref/transit-principles/favorable-wind: Favorable days cluster when applying soft transits from benefics align with the natal chart; they are windows to act, not guarantees.
